import unittest

from solution import capture_runs


class CaptureRunsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_maximal_runs_include_trailing_run(self):
        frames = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]
        selected = [True, True, False, True, False, True]
        self.assertEqual(capture_runs(frames, selected),
                         (("a", "b"), ("d",), ("f",)))

    def test_empty_and_no_selection(self):
        self.assertEqual(capture_runs([], []), ())
        self.assertEqual(capture_runs([1, 2], [False, False]), ())
        self.assertEqual(capture_runs([1, 2], [True, True]), ((1, 2),))

    def test_frames_are_deep_copied_and_independent(self):
        shared = {"nested": [1]}
        frames = [shared, shared]
        result = capture_runs(frames, [True, True])
        shared["nested"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result, (({"nested": [1]}, {"nested": [1]}),))
        result[0][0]["nested"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(result[0][1], {"nested": [1]})

    def test_validation(self):
        cases = [
            ("abc", [True, True, True]),
            ([1], "x"),
            (b"x", [True]),
            ([1], b"x"),
            ([1], []),
            ([1], [1]),
            ([1], [None]),
            (None, []),
        ]
        for frames, selected in cases:
            with self.subTest(frames=frames, selected=selected):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    capture_runs(frames, selected)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
